request.query: Multivariate polynomial rename all variables to one variable and identify with univariate polynomial

items.name: MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv
items.type:
(R : Type u) →
  [inst : CommSemiring R] → (n : ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)

items.name: MvPolynomial.pUnitAlgEquiv
items.type: (R : Type u) → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial PUnit.{u_2 + 1} R ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft
items.type: (R : Type u) → (S₁ : Type v) → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial (MvPolynomial S₁ R)

items.name: MvPolynomial.rename
items.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {τ : Type u_2} → {R : Type u_4} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ → τ) → MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial τ R

items.name: MvPolynomial.rename_X
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : σ → τ) (i : σ),
  (MvPolynomial.rename f) (MvPolynomial.X i) = MvPolynomial.X (f i)

items.name: Polynomial.toMvPolynomial_eq_rename_comp
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (i : σ),
  Polynomial.toMvPolynomial i = (MvPolynomial.rename fun x => i).comp ↑(MvPolynomial.pUnitAlgEquiv R).symm

items.name: MvPolynomial.rename_toMvPolynomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_3} {τ : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : σ → τ) (a : σ) (p : Polynomial R),
  (MvPolynomial.rename f) ((Polynomial.toMvPolynomial a) p) = (Polynomial.toMvPolynomial (f a)) p

items.name: MvPolynomial.rename_comp_toMvPolynomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_3} {τ : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : σ → τ) (a : σ),
  (MvPolynomial.rename f).comp (Polynomial.toMvPolynomial a) = Polynomial.toMvPolynomial (f a)
